Initial release of support-to-repro-pack skill.

- Converts support tickets, logs, and screenshots into sanitized, reproducible engineering issue packs.
- Guides user through input collection, PII redaction, structured log analysis, and AI review steps.
- Generates three output documents: engineering issue, internal escalation summary, and customer reply.
- Automates packaging of all sanitized artifacts for engineering handoff.
- Enforces strict PII handling and language matching based on user input.
